limits: One-member local replica set and two clients; no multinode, failover or network-fault proof.
Application reply loss follows an acknowledged real Mongo commit; session-close failure is an application observation after actual close. Neither models loss of a server response.
The 46 new cases seed the original acceptance/reservation and synthetic historical/staging metadata and bytes. They do not prove capture with files or complete remote dossier provenance.
Source, historical and staging object reads use synthetic in-memory streams and revisions. No SDK, real remote HEAD/GET, copyBatch or physical copy is exercised.
Manifest digest remains local integrity. Independent persisted byte observations grant no remote coverage, retention, source preservation, copy or business permission.
A later staging change after final HEAD deliberately remains NOT_ASSESSED and NOT_AUTHORIZED. Persisted evidence remains OBSERVED_ONLY, not remote retention.
PENDING without lease/receipt, revocation, age, expired lease, HEAD or snapshot do not close prior remote permissions or prove rollback.
Adversarial mutations and negative-index tests occur only inside owned disposable namespaces; they are not operational recovery procedures.

Block 90 harness changes were uncommitted before execution and retained. No runtime/harness fixes, public acceptance, ownership change, stable S3 cut, retention policy or business commit were enabled during the run.
